name: Straw Sandal Step Primer (Mang Hài Bộ Quyết)
notes: Depth lineage specifies names: [] (R3 no-lean element-free footwork); carries temporary lint proxy ["kim", "moc", "tho"] matching calm-wind-staff-canon until body-element-free-names is resolved. Carried art lighter-than-a-horse is element-free Physical.
concept: The guides' first method, learned on the forest road with a load on the back. It draws no element: the student breathes to the rhythm of the step and tempers the legs, the lungs and the soles of the feet, until a day's walk through wet bamboo costs no more than an hour on a dry road. Its forms are walking forms. A primer disciple is hard to knock down and harder to catch.
lore: Written by the founder Mạc Nhất Thoa in 690 for the forest boys who carried travellers' packs (A289). He named it for the line every guide learns before he learns to hold a staff: bamboo staff and straw sandals, lighter than a horse.

name: Staff Canon of the Calmed Wind and Waves (Định Phong Trượng Kinh)

notes: Early-promoted in b01 for thinh_vu holder uc_da_diep; preserved verbatim here with passive art The Long Road (d23) now supplied in xuyen_lam.effects.json. concept: Xuyên Lâm Môn's staff canon. Cultivates steadiness on the move rather than any single element.

name: Heart That Does Not Listen to the Rain (Mạc Thính Tâm Pháp)

effects.name: Do Not Listen
effects.rule: A passive ward: incoming soul damage is reduced by 15 % and charm resistance is raised by 20 %; each soul hit, song hit or pulse under Charm raises the ward by 1 stack (+5 % soul resistance and +5 % charm resistance each), fading by a tenth each second.

notes: Depth lineage specifies names: [] (element-free mind method); carries temporary lint proxy ["kim", "moc", "tho"] matching calm-wind-staff-canon. Do Not Listen is staged as a layer-1 technique Effect; Neither Wind Nor Rain is the active ward/control-shrug art at layer 2.
concept: A mind method. It teaches the cultivator to let sound, fear and the pull of another's qi pass through without answer, as rain passes through a forest. In a fight it shuts out soul and song: charms, curses and the soul hits of sound arts lose much of their force on the holder, and the holder's thần thức cannot be read. It is the founder's reply to his lord's teaching: the Tower listens to the rain; the Gate does not.
lore: Taught to the head and to one elder at a time, from master to disciple. Nhậm Bình Sinh walked the forest road on it alone for a month in 907 when the Gate refused the Night Rain arts (A292). The Tower's Hall of Echoes has never heard a word spoken in a room where two of its holders sit.
